en: Self-hosted runner: Added `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_session_queue_wait_by_reason_seconds` to the orchestrator's `/metrics`, so a re-opened session's wait can be told from a new one's
zh: 自托管运行器：新增 orchestrator 的 `/metrics` 中的 `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_session_queue_wait_by_reason_seconds`，以便区分重新打开的 session 与新建 session 的等待时间
